site.description: Fan wiki and blog for “Love is Blind” (Koi wa Mōmoku), Tatsuki Fujimoto's 2014 debut one-shot collected in 17-21: synopsis, characters, themes, timeline, trivia and essays.

game.lede: It's the day before graduation. Put these in order of importance, then check how love-blind you are.
game.win.title: 恋は盲目! Love is blind!
game.win.body: Confession first, everything else second. Ibuki would shake your hand (then run off to confess).
game.lose.title: Too sensible…
game.lose.body: You ranked like a reasonable person. Ibuki's list has exactly one thing that matters, and it's at the top.
game.drag: Drag to reorder, or use the arrow buttons.
